lesson.intro: Cuatro tiempos, una pregunta guia: que relacion tiene con el ahora y con el resto de la historia. Past Simple = hecho terminado y fechado. Past Continuous = escena de fondo o accion en curso. Present Perfect = pasado con hilo hasta el presente. Past Perfect = un pasado antes de otro pasado. Casi todos los errores de B1 vienen de confundir Past Simple con Present Perfect.

sections.heading: 1 - Past Simple: forma
sections.body:
Regulares: base + -ed (work → worked). Ortografia: termina en -e → +d (live → lived); consonante + y → -ied (study → studied); vocal + y no cambia (play → played); una silaba consonante-vocal-consonante → se dobla la consonante (stop → stopped).

Irregulares: hay que memorizarlos: go → went, see → saw, have → had, get → got, take → took, come → came, say → said, know → knew, think → thought, buy → bought, read → read.

be: was (I / he / she / it), were (you / we / they).

Negativa: didn't + base (con be: wasn't / weren't). Pregunta: Did + sujeto + base (con be: Was / Were + sujeto). El verbo principal vuelve a la forma base tras did.
examples: It was cold and the streets were empty.

sections.heading: 2 - Past Simple: uso y marcadores
sections.body:
Se usa para:

  • Acciones y estados terminados en un momento del pasado, se diga o no cuando.
  • Secuencia de acciones, una tras otra, al contar algo.
  • Habitos y estados pasados que ya no ocurren.

Marcadores: yesterday, last week/month/year, ... ago, in 1999, then, after that, when I was a child. Si sabes o preguntas cuando paso → Past Simple.
examples: I lived in Rome for three years. (ya no)

sections.heading: 3 - Past Continuous: forma y uso
sections.body:
was / were + verbo-ing. Usos:

  • Accion en progreso en un momento concreto del pasado: At 9 p.m. I was studying.
  • Dos acciones largas en paralelo: While she was cooking, I was setting the table.
  • Escena de fondo de una historia: The sun was shining, birds were singing.

Ortografia del -ing igual que en presente. Los verbos de estado (know, want, like...) normalmente no van en Past Continuous.
examples: They were arguing while the kids were watching TV.
It was raining and the wind was blowing.

sections.heading: 4 - Past Simple vs Past Continuous
sections.body:
Regla clave: la accion larga (en progreso) va en Past Continuous; la accion corta que la interrumpe va en Past Simple.

Conectores: while + accion larga (-ing); when + accion corta (Past Simple). Dos acciones cortas y sucesivas → las dos en Past Simple.

El Past Continuous pone el decorado; el Past Simple cuenta los hechos.
examples: I was having a shower when the phone rang.
While I was walking home, I found a wallet.

sections.heading: 5 - Present Perfect: forma
sections.body:
have / has + participio pasado. Participio de regulares = -ed; los irregulares tienen forma propia: be → been, go → gone/been, do → done, see → seen, write → written, break → broken, take → taken, give → given, eat → eaten, come → come, read → read.

Negativa: haven't / hasn't + participio. Pregunta: Have / Has + sujeto + participio. Contracciones: I've, you've, he's (= he has), we've...

sections.heading: 6 - Present Perfect: uso (ever, just, yet, for/since)
sections.body:
Conecta el pasado con el presente. Usos:

  • Experiencias de vida sin decir cuando: Have you ever...? / I've never...
  • Resultado visible ahora: I've lost my keys (no las tengo).
  • Tiempo no terminado: today, this week, this year, so far.

Adverbios: just (hace un momento, tras have); already (antes de lo esperado, en afirmativas, tras have); yet (todavia; en negativas y preguntas, al final). for + periodo (for two years); since + punto de inicio (since 2010, since Monday).

sections.heading: 7 - Present Perfect vs Past Simple
sections.body:
Past Simple = tiempo terminado y a menudo concreto (yesterday, last..., ago, in 1990) o preguntas con when.

Present Perfect = tiempo no terminado o sin especificar, con conexion al presente.

been = fue y ya volvio (She's been to the bank). gone = fue y sigue alli (She's gone to the bank).

Con for / since y algo que continua → Present Perfect (I've lived here for 5 years = sigo aqui); si ya no continua → Past Simple (I lived there for 5 years).
examples: I've seen that film. - I saw it last night.
Have you ever been to Rome? - When did you go?
He's gone home (no esta). - He's been to the doctor (ya volvio).

sections.heading: 8 - Past Perfect: forma y uso
sections.body:
had + participio pasado (igual para todas las personas). Expresa una accion anterior a otro momento o accion del pasado: primero paso A (Past Perfect), luego B (Past Simple).

Util con when, after, before, by the time, already, just, never... before. Negativa: hadn't + participio. Pregunta: Had + sujeto + participio.

Si el orden ya esta claro por after / before, se puede usar Past Simple, pero el Past Perfect deja la anterioridad explicita.
examples: When we arrived, the film had already started.
She couldn't pay because she had left her wallet at home.
I had never seen snow before that trip.

contrast.title: Present Perfect o Past Simple?
rows: Ir y volver / ir y seguir alli

mistakes: NO: I have seen him yesterday. -> SI: I saw him yesterday.
NO: Did you ever be to Japan? -> SI: Have you ever been to Japan?
NO: She has gone to Paris and she's back now. -> SI: She has been to Paris.
NO: When I was a child I was living on a farm. -> SI: When I was a child I lived on a farm.
NO: He didn't went to school. -> SI: He didn't go to school.
NO: I was knowing the answer. -> SI: I knew the answer.
NO: They arrived after the film started. -> SI: They arrived after the film had started.

sources.label: Test-English - Past simple or present perfect (B1)

questions.prompt: Completa: Yesterday I ___ (watch) a film.
questions.explanation: Regular: base + -ed -> watched.

questions.prompt: Completa: She ___ (study) all night.
questions.explanation: Consonante + y -> -ied: studied.

questions.prompt: Completa: They ___ (stop) at the border.
questions.explanation: Consonante-vocal-consonante -> se dobla: stopped.

questions.prompt: Completa: We ___ (arrive) late.
questions.explanation: Termina en -e -> +d: arrived.

questions.prompt: He ___ to Rome last year.
questions.explanation: 'go' es irregular: went.

questions.prompt: I ___ my keys yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'lose' es irregular: lost.

questions.prompt: ___ you ___ the news?
questions.explanation: Pregunta en pasado: Did + sujeto + verbo base.

questions.prompt: She ___ come to the party.
questions.explanation: Negativa en pasado: didn't + base.

questions.prompt: They ___ at home yesterday evening.
questions.explanation: 'they' -> were.

questions.prompt: It ___ very cold last night.
questions.explanation: 'it' -> was.

questions.prompt: Cual oracion es correcta?
questions.explanation: didn't + verbo en forma base (sin -ed).

questions.prompt: Completa: The baby ___ (cry) for an hour.
questions.explanation: Consonante + y -> -ied: cried.

questions.prompt: I ___ a great book last week.
questions.explanation: 'read' es irregular: se escribe igual (se pronuncia /red/).

questions.prompt: I saw her ___.
questions.explanation: 'ago' marca un tiempo terminado -> Past Simple.

questions.prompt: We moved here ___.
questions.explanation: Fecha concreta y terminada -> Past Simple.

questions.prompt: First he ___ up, then he ___ breakfast.
questions.explanation: Secuencia de acciones terminadas -> Past Simple.

questions.prompt: ___ you enjoy the concert last night?
questions.explanation: 'last night' es tiempo terminado -> Did.

questions.prompt: Shakespeare ___ many plays.
questions.explanation: Vida terminada -> Past Simple.

questions.prompt: When I ___ young, I ___ in a village.
questions.explanation: Estado y habito pasados que ya no ocurren -> Past Simple.

questions.prompt: They ___ dinner and then ___ TV.
questions.explanation: Dos acciones sucesivas y terminadas -> Past Simple.

questions.prompt: I ___ him at the meeting yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'yesterday' -> Past Simple.

questions.prompt: Completa: She ___ (leave) an hour ago.
questions.explanation: 'ago' -> Past Simple; 'leave' es irregular: left.

questions.prompt: The Romans ___ this city 2,000 years ago.
questions.explanation: Tiempo concreto y lejano -> Past Simple.

questions.prompt: ___ did you go on holiday last summer?
questions.explanation: Pregunta con 'did' sobre un tiempo concreto (last summer).

questions.prompt: He ___ born in 1990.
questions.explanation: 'be born' en pasado: was / were born.

questions.prompt: Completa: At 8 p.m. yesterday I ___ (have) dinner.
questions.explanation: Accion en progreso a una hora concreta del pasado -> was/were + -ing.

questions.prompt: While she ___, the phone rang.
questions.explanation: Accion larga en curso -> Past Continuous.

questions.prompt: They ___ while I ___.
questions.explanation: Dos acciones largas en paralelo -> Past Continuous en las dos.

questions.prompt: It ___ and the birds ___. (descripcion de fondo)
questions.explanation: Escena de fondo -> Past Continuous.

questions.prompt: What ___ you ___ at 10 last night?
questions.explanation: Pregunta sobre una accion en curso a una hora -> were + sujeto + -ing.

questions.prompt: I ___ TV when you called.
questions.explanation: Accion en curso interrumpida -> Past Continuous.

questions.prompt: He ___ fast when the accident happened.
questions.explanation: Accion en progreso de fondo -> Past Continuous.

questions.prompt: Completa: We ___ (wait) for the bus when it started to snow.
questions.explanation: Accion larga interrumpida -> were + -ing.

questions.prompt: This time last week I ___ on a beach.
questions.explanation: Accion en progreso en un momento del pasado -> Past Continuous.

questions.prompt: ___ they ___ when the teacher came in?
questions.explanation: Pregunta: Were + sujeto plural + -ing.

questions.prompt: The sun ___ when we left.
questions.explanation: Escena de fondo -> Past Continuous.

questions.prompt: I couldn't answer because I ___.
questions.explanation: Situacion en curso que explica el contexto -> Past Continuous.

questions.prompt: When I arrived, everyone ___ a good time.
questions.explanation: Situacion ya en curso al llegar -> Past Continuous.

questions.prompt: I ___ when the lights ___ out.
questions.explanation: Accion larga (Continuous) interrumpida por una corta (Simple).

questions.prompt: When the film ___, we ___ home.
questions.explanation: Dos acciones cortas y sucesivas -> las dos en Past Simple.

questions.prompt: While we ___ dinner, someone ___ on the door.
questions.explanation: 'while' + accion larga (-ing); la corta en Past Simple.

questions.prompt: He ___ his leg while he ___ football.
questions.explanation: La corta (break) en Simple; la larga (play) en Continuous.

questions.prompt: When I ___ in, she ___ on the phone.
questions.explanation: Llegada (corta, Simple); hablar por telefono ya en curso (Continuous).

questions.prompt: Con 'when', que combinacion es la tipica?
options: accion corta (Simple) que interrumpe a una larga (-ing)
questions.answer: accion corta (Simple) que interrumpe a una larga (-ing)
questions.explanation: 'when' suele introducir la accion corta que corta a la larga.

questions.prompt: I ___ TV for two hours and then went to bed.
questions.explanation: Accion completada con duracion cerrada y secuencia -> Past Simple.

questions.prompt: As I ___ down the street, I ___ an old friend.
questions.explanation: Fondo en curso (walk) + hecho puntual (meet).

questions.prompt: The kids ___ when their mother ___.
questions.explanation: Estado en curso (sleep) + llegada puntual (arrive).

questions.prompt: We ___ the game because it ___ heavily.
questions.explanation: Decision puntual (stop) + fondo en curso (rain).

questions.prompt: She ___ her homework, then she ___ out.
questions.explanation: Secuencia de dos acciones terminadas -> Past Simple.

questions.prompt: I ___ my wallet while I ___ on the bus.
questions.explanation: Hecho puntual (lose) + fondo largo (travel).

questions.prompt: Completa: I ___ (finish) my work.
questions.explanation: have + participio (regular: -ed).

questions.prompt: She ___ to Japan.
questions.explanation: 3a persona -> has + participio (been).

questions.prompt: They ___ eaten yet.
questions.explanation: Sujeto plural -> haven't + participio.

questions.prompt: ___ you ever ___ a marathon?
questions.explanation: Participio de 'run' = run.

questions.prompt: Completa: He ___ (break) his arm.
questions.explanation: Participio de 'break' = broken; 3a persona -> has.

questions.prompt: Completa: We ___ (see) that film twice.
questions.explanation: Participio de 'see' = seen.

questions.prompt: Completa: She has ___ (go) home already.
questions.explanation: Participio de 'go' = gone.

questions.prompt: Completa: I ___ (write) three emails today.
questions.explanation: Participio de 'write' = written.

questions.prompt: Cual oracion es correcta?
questions.explanation: has + participio (done).

questions.prompt: Completa: They ___ (not / arrive) yet.
questions.explanation: Negativa: haven't + participio.

questions.prompt: 'I've' es la contraccion de:
questions.explanation: En Present Perfect, 've = have.

questions.prompt: Completa (pregunta): ___ (you / meet) her before?
questions.explanation: Pregunta: Have + sujeto + participio (met).

questions.prompt: Completa: The train ___ (leave) already.
questions.explanation: Participio de 'leave' = left; 'the train' -> has.

questions.prompt: I've ___ been to Australia.
questions.explanation: Experiencia de vida -> Present Perfect con ever / never.

questions.prompt: She's ___ finished the report. (antes de lo esperado)
questions.explanation: 'already' en afirmativas, tras 'have'.

questions.prompt: Have you done your homework ___?
questions.explanation: 'yet' al final, en preguntas y negativas.

questions.prompt: He's ___ arrived - he's at the door.
questions.explanation: 'just' = hace un momento, tras 'have'.

questions.prompt: I've lived here ___ 2010.
questions.explanation: 'since' + punto de inicio.

questions.prompt: We've known each other ___ ten years.
questions.explanation: 'for' + periodo de tiempo.

questions.prompt: I can't find my phone. I ___ it.
questions.explanation: Resultado presente: ahora no lo tengo -> Present Perfect.

questions.prompt: ___ you ever ___ a celebrity?
questions.explanation: Experiencia -> Have + sujeto + participio.

questions.prompt: She ___ three coffees today. (el dia no ha terminado)
questions.explanation: Tiempo no terminado ('today') -> Present Perfect.

questions.prompt: The city has changed a lot ___.
questions.explanation: 'recently' es compatible con el Present Perfect.

questions.prompt: I haven't seen him ___ Friday.
questions.explanation: 'since' + dia concreto de inicio.

questions.prompt: Where's Tom? He ___ out.
questions.explanation: Resultado presente: no esta aqui -> has gone.

questions.prompt: I ___ my homework. Can I watch TV now?
questions.explanation: Resultado presente, sin decir cuando -> Present Perfect.

questions.prompt: I ___ my homework two hours ago.
questions.explanation: 'ago' -> tiempo terminado -> Past Simple.

questions.prompt: ___ you ever ___ to Egypt?
questions.explanation: Experiencia -> Present Perfect con 'been'.

questions.prompt: When ___ you ___ to Egypt?
questions.explanation: 'When' pide un tiempo concreto -> Past Simple.

questions.prompt: She's not here. She ___ to the bank.
questions.explanation: 'gone' = fue y no ha vuelto.

questions.prompt: She looks tired. She ___ to the gym.
questions.explanation: 'been' = fue y ya ha vuelto.

questions.prompt: We ___ this film last night.
questions.explanation: 'last night' terminado -> Past Simple.

questions.prompt: I ___ this film three times. (en mi vida)
questions.explanation: Experiencia acumulada hasta ahora -> Present Perfect.

questions.prompt: Marie Curie ___ two Nobel Prizes.
questions.explanation: Persona fallecida / vida terminada -> Past Simple.

questions.prompt: My sister ___ in Berlin since March.
questions.explanation: Periodo que llega hasta ahora ('since') -> Present Perfect.

questions.prompt: My sister ___ in Berlin for two years, then moved to Paris.
questions.explanation: Periodo terminado (ya se mudo) -> Past Simple.

questions.prompt: 'This morning I ___ three teas.' (dicho a las 11 a.m.)
questions.explanation: La manana aun no ha terminado -> Present Perfect.

questions.prompt: 'This morning I ___ three teas.' (dicho por la noche)
questions.explanation: La manana ya termino -> Past Simple.

questions.prompt: Completa: When we arrived, the film ___ (already / start).
questions.explanation: Accion anterior a otra pasada -> had + participio; 'already' entre had y el participio.

questions.prompt: She ___ before I got there.
questions.explanation: Accion anterior a otra pasada -> Past Perfect.

questions.prompt: I couldn't get in because I ___ my keys.
questions.explanation: La perdida ocurrio antes del momento pasado -> Past Perfect.

questions.prompt: By the time the police came, the thief ___.
questions.explanation: 'by the time' + accion previa -> Past Perfect.

questions.prompt: After he ___ dinner, he went to bed.
questions.explanation: 'after' + accion previa -> Past Perfect (participio de 'have' = had).

questions.prompt: Completa: They ___ (not / meet) before the wedding.
questions.explanation: Negativa del Past Perfect: hadn't + participio.

questions.prompt: The ground was wet because it ___.
questions.explanation: Causa anterior al momento pasado -> Past Perfect.

questions.prompt: ___ the train ___ when you got to the station?
questions.explanation: Pregunta del Past Perfect: Had + sujeto + participio.

questions.prompt: She told me she ___ him somewhere before.
questions.explanation: Accion anterior al momento del relato -> Past Perfect.

questions.prompt: I was nervous because I ___ never ___ a plane before.
questions.explanation: Experiencia (o su ausencia) antes de un momento pasado -> Past Perfect; participio de 'fly' = flown.

questions.prompt: We ___ just ___ when the guests arrived.
questions.explanation: Accion recien terminada antes de otra pasada -> had just + participio.

questions.prompt: He passed easily because he ___ for weeks beforehand.
questions.explanation: Preparacion anterior al examen (momento pasado) -> Past Perfect.
